edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from the caller-controlled msg.sender, granting privileged access.
msg.sender is used to index balances in transfer.
balances mapping is read in transfer.
Destination parameter _to flows into transfer.
Value parameter _value flows into transfer.
paused flag guards the transfer execution path.
transfer performs subtraction on the sender balance.
Subtraction result is written back to balances.
balances value feeds the subtraction operand.
transfer performs addition on the receiver balance.
Addition result is written back to balances.
msg.sender indexes the allowance in transferFrom.
allowed mapping is read in transferFrom.
balances mapping is read in transferFrom.
Source parameter _from flows into transferFrom.
Destination parameter _to flows into transferFrom.
Value parameter _value flows into transferFrom.
paused flag guards the transferFrom execution path.
transferFrom subtracts from the allowance.
Reduced allowance is written back into allowed.
Current allowance feeds the subtraction operand.
transferFrom subtracts from the source balance.
msg.sender is validated against owner by the onlyOwner modifier in mint.
balances mapping is written in mint.
totalSupply_ is updated in mint.
Amount parameter _amount flows into mint.
owner gates mint through onlyOwner.
mintingFinished gates mint through canMint.
mint adds to total supply.
New total supply is written back to totalSupply_.
Current total supply feeds the addition operand.
mint adds to the receiver balance.
balances mapping is read and written in _burn.
totalSupply_ is updated in _burn.
_burn subtracts from total supply.
Reduced total supply is written back to totalSupply_.
Current total supply feeds the subtraction operand.
_burn subtracts from the target balance.
msg.sender is validated against owner by onlyOwner in freezeTo.
balances mapping is read and written in freezeTo.
frozenBalance mapping is updated in freezeTo.
owner gates freezeTo through onlyOwner.
freezeTo adds to the frozen balance.
Increased frozen amount is written to frozenBalance.
Current frozen amount feeds the addition operand.
freezeTo adds to the receiver balance.
frozenBalance mapping is updated in unfreezeFrom.
owner gates unfreezeFrom through onlyOwner.
unfreezeFrom subtracts from the frozen balance.
Reduced frozen amount is written to frozenBalance.
Current frozen amount feeds the subtraction operand.
totalSupply_ is updated in mintAndFreeze.
frozenBalance mapping is updated in mintAndFreeze.
owner gates mintAndFreeze through onlyOwner.
mintingFinished gates mintAndFreeze through canMint.
mintAndFreeze adds to total supply.
mintAndFreeze adds to the frozen balance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
allowed mapping is written in approve.
Spender parameter _spender flows into approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in increaseApproval.
allowed mapping is read and written in increaseApproval.
increaseApproval accumulates onto the allowance entry.
allowed mapping is read and written in decreaseApproval.
Cached oldValue local drives the decreaseApproval branch.
decreaseApproval subtracts from the allowance.
decreaseApproval writes the reduced or zeroed allowance.
frozenAccounts mapping is written in freezeAccount.
owner gates freezeAccount through onlyOwner.
blocklistedAccounts mapping is written in blockAccount.
owner gates blockAccount through onlyOwner.
blocklistedAccounts is required to be true in destroyBlockedFunds.
owner gates destroyBlockedFunds through onlyOwner.
destroyBlockedFunds delegates the balance wipe to _burn.
msg.sender is checked against frozenAccounts in the freezable transfer override.
frozenAccounts flag gates the freezable transfer override.
balances are read for the usable balance check in the freezable transfer override.
frozenBalance is read for the usable balance check in the freezable transfer override.
freezable transfer calls super.transfer execution path.
msg.sender is checked against frozenAccounts in the freezable transferFrom override.
frozenAccounts flag gates the freezable transferFrom override.
balances are read for the usable balance check in the freezable transferFrom override.
frozenBalance is read for the usable balance check in the freezable transferFrom override.
freezable transferFrom calls super.transferFrom execution path.
msg.sender is checked against the blocklist in the burnable transfer override.
blocklistedAccounts flag gates the burnable transfer override.
burnable transfer calls super.transfer execution path.
msg.sender is checked against the blocklist in the burnable transferFrom override.
blocklistedAccounts flag gates the burnable transferFrom override.
burnable transferFrom calls super.transferFrom execution path.
owner gates burn through onlyOwner.
burn delegates the balance reduction to _burn.
balances mapping is read in usableBalanceOf.
frozenBalance mapping is read in usableBalanceOf.
usableBalanceOf subtracts frozenBalance from balances.
paused flag is read and set by pause.
pause writes true to paused.
owner gates pause through onlyOwner.
owner gates unpause through onlyOwner.
unpause writes false to paused.
renounceOwnership reads the current owner.
renounceOwnership zeroes the owner state variable.
owner gates transferOwnership through onlyOwner.
New owner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
transferOwnership delegates to _transferOwnership.
New owner parameter flows into _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership reads the current owner for the event.
_transferOwnership writes the new privileged owner.

Local result c flows out of SafeMath.add.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination address parameter _to only exists to feed the transfer/transferFrom entrypoints and carries no independent semantics.
Value parameter _value is a plain transfer amount consumed directly by transfer and transferFrom.
Source address parameter _from is only meaningful inside transferFrom allowance and balance checks.
Spender parameter _spender is only used to key the allowed mapping inside approve.
New owner parameter is only consumed by the ownership handover path.
Mint amount parameter _amount only feeds the minting total-supply and balance updates.
Local cache oldValue exists solely to drive the decreaseApproval branch and subtraction.
Local result variable c only holds the checked addition result inside SafeMath.add.
